name: Game Design and Simulation
promise: Turn game rules into simulations, balance evidence, and playable artifacts.
completion_criteria: A real game pack preserves complete rules, seeded simulation, metrics, reports, and printable artifacts.
Tucked in Terrors statistical outputs match or improve on the dedicated simulator with versioned evidence.
Authored games remain independently owned artifacts unless a proven shared mechanic justifies a pack.

waves.objective: Fingerprint Tucked in Terrors rules, seeds, metrics, and report outputs.
waves.acceptance: The parity fixture captures game version, configuration, runs, statistics, and expected tolerances.
waves.runtime_followup: Re-run the donor simulator to regenerate the sample instead of fingerprinting its retained run.

waves.objective: Project the recorded game rows into Storyweaver reference-pack vocabulary.
waves.acceptance: The suite-local shape projection is validated without claiming on-disk pack materialization, independent resimulation, statistical parity, or Storyweaver runtime execution.
waves.runtime_followup: Materialize the pack, run it in Storyweaver, and compare independently generated statistics to the donor sample.

waves.objective: Document the authored-game boundary and optional pack contract.
waves.acceptance: Creative assets are preserved without inventing an all-games platform or ownership transfer.
waves.runtime_followup: Re-audit if authored content ever gains a pack export path.

waves.objective: Project a second structurally different fixture into Storyweaver pack vocabulary.
waves.acceptance: The suite-local branching spatial-puzzle shape validates against the declared slots; Storyweaver has not generated or run the pack.
waves.runtime_followup: Generate the adventure pack through Storyweaver itself and diff the written gds slots.

waves.objective: Formally audit authored-game boundary for March Madness sports simulation.
waves.acceptance: Specialized simulation confirmed as independent creative domain without mandatory engine coupling.
waves.runtime_followup: Re-audit if the simulation is ever scheduled for a port into the suite.
